source.text:
# Defer-lift (RT-5 shape). A UDF that creates, feeds, and *returns* a defer
# channel. Inlining the call produces `let totals = (feed-prefix; let t = Defer
# in t) in ...` — the shape `try_lift_defer` rewrites by merging the inner and
# outer defer scopes. The lifted feed head must keep its NodeId (preserve, not
# mint) so its source span survives into the post-channelize span index.
def make_totals(xs):
    t = defer()
    t << sum(xs)
    t

readings = [1, 2, 3, 4]
totals = make_totals(readings)
max(totals)
